newsitem.title: USA: Citizens completes Farmers & Mechanics merger.
newsitem.headline: Citizens completes Farmers & Mechanics merger.

text.p: Citizens Financial Group Inc said on Monday it completed the acquisition of Farmers & Mechanics Bank of Middletown, Connecticut for $53.2 million.
Farmers & Mechanics' $540 million assets and 12 branches will be merged into Citizens' London-based subsidiary Citizens Bank-Connecticut.

Citizens Financial is a New England-based financial services company. Citizens is a 76.5 percent-owned subsidiary of Royal Bank of Scotland Group Plc. Bank of Ireland holds the remaining 23.5 percent interest.
